verdict.rationale: No evidence of any programmatic/API surface for drafting option grants or other securities—OpenAPI/swagger probes all return 404, and all cited docs describe human UI workflows (admin authorizes share pools, recipients submit exercise requests via the platform) rather than an agent-accessible API queue. missing for 10: any API/SDK endpoint for creating draft grants, evidence of an approval-queue object model, developer documentation referencing programmatic access.
